findings.rationale: The biography contained an uncited industrial temperature claim and no boundary between personal experience and scientific authority. The correction removes the irrelevant quantitative claim and adds the boundary.
The page said active development despite containing no review. It now uses the planned state and disclaims a publication commitment.
The page implied active priorities and a prompt personal response. It now routes public work to the tracker and states the acceptance and response boundaries.
The channels resolved but their visibility and non-guarantee boundaries were implicit. The page now states them directly.
The page used formatted references without resolvable links and could make two distinct mechanisms look evidentially equivalent. It now links primary papers and labels the comparison as analogy.

The roadmap contradicted its own live-status rule with stale percentages, deadlines, completion claims, and incorrect engine tiers. It is now an evergreen issue/merge authority map with a pinned support contract.

A series card said ZTCF separates passive dynamics from deliberate torque, exceeding the protected intervention contract. It now describes model-conditioned interventions and rejects unique muscular or intent inference.
The page description called the bounded editorial program a comprehensive theory series. It now identifies the series as editorial without implying exhaustive theoretical coverage.
The wrapper exposed normative definitions without stating that semantic authority is not empirical validation. The new callout makes the boundary explicit.

Mobile browser review found canonical quaternion and vector norm rows malformed and wide reference tables clipped without a local scroll affordance. The canonical rows are repaired and notation tables now scroll within a page-scoped container.

The overview used a nonexistent verification path, wrong REST route and request fields, unpinned main links, and overstated engine support. The corrected example and tiers match protected UpstreamDrift source.

The quick start conflated the package metadata lower bound with open-ended interpreter support by saying Python 3.11 or newer. It now separates requires-python >=3.11 from the tested Python 3.11 and 3.12 minors and explicitly withholds Python 3.13 qualification.

The landing page used comparative superlatives for its reading path and could blur tangent-map linearity with nonlinear flow. The corrected status and locality statement close both amplification paths.

Calling the unified thesis the complete reference manuscript amplified completeness beyond the route's experimental and article-bounded authority. It is now described only as the single-file reference manuscript.

The hub repeated exact percentages, proof language, performance numbers, and causal conclusions from downstream pages whose route audits remain separate. The rewritten hub uses topic summaries and page-specific state boundaries.

The hub advertised proper kinematics, full control, and comprehensive biomechanical visualization without a qualification boundary. It now labels the reduced wrist tools experimental and bounds interpretation.
